# memory

Trigger words: `memory`, `remember`, `recall`, `note this`, `save this`, `what do we know about`

When the user types any of these trigger words, invoke the memory-keeper agent (`agents/memory-keeper.md`).

| The user says | What to do |
|---------------|------------|
| `memory` (alone) or `show memory` | Show a summary of both stores — what's in short-term and long-term. |
| `remember <fact>`, `note this`, `save this` | Save the fact. If it's clearly durable (convention, decision, pattern), save to long-term. Otherwise save to short-term. Ask if unclear. |
| `recall <topic>`, `what do we know about <X>` | Search both stores, surface the most relevant entry. |
| `clear short-term`, `reset session` | Archive short-term: promote any durable entries to long-term, then clear the file. |
